name: admin-auth
description: Better Auth as an OIDC provider for the ALB authenticate-oidc gate (Google Workspace login, admin allowlist. AWS Lambda behind the ALB in production)

scripts.bundle: esbuild index=src/lambda.ts ops=src/ops.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --sourcemap --outdir=dist-lambda --out-extension:.js=.mjs --external:@aws-sdk/* --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
